hypothesis: The original trained MTP head can amortize target verification enough to improve real greedy generation under the same memory budget.
expected_effect: Preserve target output/state while making three actual proposals per four-input verifier block.
controlled_change: Native prepared MTP Q4 experts/Q8 dense head, 32 draft slots and 1460 target slots, delayed host checkpoint commitment; shared target embedding/head and total 12GiB admission.
correctness: Independent NumPy equations pass 22 synthetic and 22 real-hidden boundaries; exact serial/block state, eviction, causal prefix and rollback checks; forced target rejection replay; final target state equals fresh serial.
outcome: One clean short pair: serial 3.639327 tokens/s, real MTP 4.790415 tokens/s, latency ratio 0.759710. All12 proposals accepted over16 committed inputs. Validation peak9.824GiB; timing peaks9.766/9.696GiB. Two earlier128-slot runs remain compression-blocked.
smallest_experiment: Skip unused attention-query/MoE/output work during target-aligned draft state catch-up; prove identical cache bytes and future proposals before a fresh paired screen.
limitations: Single72-token prompt and16-token continuation; one timing pair has no confidence qualification.
The5-token/s target, long contexts, sustained sessions, tool-use and non-greedy sampling remain unqualified.
Prepared draft-only quantization is not originalBF16 equivalence. Production is unchanged.
